announcements.title: We have a building!
announcements.content: Alhamdulillāh! We have been successful in purchasing the building! May Allāh reward each and every one of you who contributed! However, the work is not done. We still need your duās and contributions. JazākAllāhu khayran wa bārakAllāhu feek!
